rationale: Water damage to the policyholder's own basement, hardwood flooring, drywall, and stored contents caused by a burst supply line on the policyholder's property is classic property damage coverage.
claim_summary: Sam Patel's basement flooded due to a burst water supply line while policyholder was away on a work trip. Approximately 2 inches of water across the entire basement has caused significant damage: hardwood flooring is buckled, drywall soaked up to 1 foot, and stored boxes ruined. Estimated damage appears to exceed $25,000 and requires urgent on-site assessment.

rationale: Wind damage to the policyholder's own roof structure (shingles on back porch overhang) is direct property damage to the home itself.
claim_summary: Wind damage claim from POL-1006: four roof shingles blown off back porch overhang during high winds last weekend. No interior water intrusion. Estimated repair cost $400. Low severity, but deductible is $2,500, so claim may not be payable.
